## User Story
As a [role], I need [function], so that [benefit].

## Acceptance Criteria
Given [context], When [action], Then [outcome].

### EXAMPLE:
**User Story:**
As a registered user, I need to log in, so that I can access my dashboard.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
Given I am on the login page, When I enter valid credentials, Then I should be redirected to the dashboard.**
